action: Ipsos clients: no action required yet. You may ask your account contact whether the affected system held your data, and watch for an official update.
exec: A limited intrusion at a global research firm that holds client and survey data; no data loss figures have been given.
plain: Market research company Ipsos said on November 16 that intruders got into one of its internal systems. It reported no effect on its operations and has filed a complaint with the authorities.

sources.name: Ipsos press release via Finanzwire (16 November 2026)

summary: Ipsos announced on November 16 that it had filed a complaint with the authorities on November 11 over a breach of one internal information system. It says it contained the incident, engaged external specialists, and that operations and client delivery were not affected. The investigation continues; it will contact clients if their data was affected. No attacker has been named.
title: Ipsos says hackers accessed one internal system

validation.note: Company press release read in full; MLQ and Windows Forum agree.

review.note: Added Ipsos press release: complaint filed Nov 11, announced Nov 16, no operational impact; now corroborated
